artifacts.summary: Re-verifies the dispatch's duplication/bug/collision claims against the live source store, finds commands/todo.md should survive as the sole authoritative /todo implementation with skill-todo fully removed (not thin-delegated), and surfaces a fourth divergence surface (TODO.md-orphan detection) and a stale collision-field snapshot (task 626) the dispatch did not account for.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, a command-skill pair where the command's allowed-tools line carries no Skill entry structurally cannot dispatch the paired skill, regardless of what either file's prose claims. Verify by grepping the command's allowed-tools frontmatter for 'Skill' before trusting a skill's description/role text as evidence it is live.

This repo deploys /todo twice: once for Claude Code (agent-system/extensions/core/commands/todo.md -> .claude/) and once for OpenCode (.opencode/commands/todo.md, a separately-maintained copy). The OpenCode copy can diverge and go stale independently of the core source store without tripping the .claude/-focused deploy-freshness check. When auditing a core command's live callers, check both deploy trees, not just .claude/.

A task's stored file_scope is anticipatory, not a ceiling: task 458's file_scope (7 paths) was measurably narrower than the full set of registry/lint/test files actually referencing the target symbol (skill-todo) once enumerated with a repo-wide grep. When a dispatch names a removal/consolidation target, re-enumerate its full reference footprint rather than trusting file_scope to already list every touch point.
